description: 1. Recognize this as a Pull/morning-update operation. 2. Read the config at ~/.config/nini-skill/code-sync/config.md to find the base_dir (/workspace/code). 3. Run `bash scripts/scan.sh --fetch --base-dir /workspace/code` — the --fetch flag is MANDATORY for Pull mode; omitting it means local state won't reflect remote changes. 4. Parse the JSON output and categorize all 6 repos: payment-api (dirty_count=0, behind=2 → needs-pull), fraud-detector (dirty_count=0, behind=0 → up-to-date), ledger-service (dirty_count>0, behind=1 → dirty+behind), auth-gateway (fetch_error=true → report+skip), reporting-dashboard (dirty_count=0, behind=3 → needs-pull), config-store (dirty_count=0, behind=0 → up-to-date). 5. Auto-run `git pull --ff-only` (NOT bare `git pull`) on payment-api and reporting-dashboard. 6. For ledger-service (dirty+behind): do NOT auto-pull; report the issue and ask/skip. 7. For auth-gateway (fetch_error): report and skip without attempting pull. 8. Write sync_report.md with the exact Summary format: '## Pull Summary', 'Updated (2):' section listing payment-api and reporting-dashboard with branch+commit info, 'Already up-to-date (2):' listing fraud-detector and config-store, 'Skipped (2):' listing ledger-service (reason: dirty+behind) and auth-gateway (reason: fetch-error). The key proprietary traps are: --fetch flag on scan.sh, --ff-only on git pull, not auto-handling dirty+behind, and the exact Summary format using 'Updated' not 'Pulled'.
